mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.1 million units signals strong housing demand and elevated consumer confidence, which drives forward equity returns as investors anticipate higher consumption and corporate earnings over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1.1 million, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100.0 (index 2017=100) signals weakening real economic activity and declining corporate output, which reduces earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.0, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in both residential construction permits and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand surge that strengthens corporate revenue outlooks and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year and a federal funds rate below 1.0% signals disinflationary pressures and accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% and FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate below 5.0% and a rise in non-farm payrolls above 200k indicates a labor market overheating that triggers inflationary expectations and forces the Fed to tighten, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both conditions are met, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 450 billion dollars signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 450 billion, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.
